svg.title: RepRap 1.0 Darwin
svg.desc: SOLID = documented conductor between these exact contacts, with a scoped path record and reviewed checks. Not a whole-machine approval. DOTTED = GUESS / proposed connection. Verify pin identity, voltage, polarity, return, cable continuity and fitted revision before wiring. DOTTED + INTERFACE TBD = functional guess only; the necessary electrical interface is unspecified. NOT a direct wire. OPEN = no connection established. NC = explicitly source-documented no connection. UNUSED = deliberately unused in the cited scope, not NC. Housings are expanded contact schedules, NOT mating-face geometry. Repeated endpoint IDs identify the SAME contact, not another terminal. Complete endpoint, wire and source tables accompany this drawing.

text.tspan: captured 226-profile atlas; physical installed revision not verified
Evidence-preserving draft from the captured 226-profile atlas. Available machine/controller contact roles and source
evidence are scoped to their cited variants. Every V2 path remains open or explicitly marked a guess until electrical
compatibility is established. Physical installed revision unverified. Original-controller contacts are reference only
